en.title: Toast with Grain

steps.n1: Sauté the minced garlic in oil with the green pepper.
steps.n2: Spread this mixture onto the toast.
steps.n3: Layer the osag on top, followed by the cheese squares and the luncheon meat slices.
steps.n4: Cover with a second slice of toast and garnish with lettuce and tomato rings.

legacySteps: Sauté the minced garlic in oil with the green pepper.
Spread this mixture onto the toast.

Cover with a second slice of toast and garnish with lettuce and tomato rings.
